newsitem.title: USA: Bencivenga joins BT Securities high-yield group.
newsitem.headline: Bencivenga joins BT Securities high-yield group.

text.p: Joseph Bencivenga, a veteran Wall Street executive, has joined the high yield capital markets group at BT Securities, a unit of Bankers Trust New York Corp.

Bencivenga was managing director and head of equity emerging markets at Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc from 1995 to 1996. Previously, he was head of fixed income research at Salomon Brothers, a unit of Salomon Inc.
Bencivenga, who will be a managing director, will report to Art Penn, managing director and head of the high yield capital markets group.
